classification_rationale: The recovered OOF is UNCALIBRATED by design (walk-forward, is_calibrated=False for all 34,636 rows) to avoid validation/test calibration leakage. evaluate_pure_oof scores these uncalibrated PMFs directly against exact same-book no-vig quotes, so NO calibrator (neither the run-time nor the post-merge 24c2618d refit) is applied to the historical OOF rows. The post-merge calibrator refit therefore cannot leak into or alter the authoritative historical evaluation. A CALIBRATED historical evaluation would instead REQUIRE_NEW_CROSSFIT (per-fold chronological calibrators referenced by the run manifest); that is out of scope for the uncalibrated authoritative OOF measurement.
